<a id="js2"></a>

### JS2: A time limit and readable errors for all JavaScript

**partial** · [Guide](05-javascript.md)

Current note: Bounded cancellable background jobs provide JSON-only workers and game-thread completion. Synchronous Java and compiled classes remain outside safe forced preemption.

Native calls cannot be safely force-stopped on the game thread. Use
interpreted budgets or JSON background jobs with explicit I/O timeouts.

Implementation: [JSRuntime.java](../../CoffeeMud/com/planet_ink/coffee_mud/core/JSRuntime.java).
